name: What should I ask before hiring a luxury home builder?

mainEntity.name: What questions separate a real luxury builder from a general contractor on a custom home project?
mainEntity.text: What questions separate a real luxury builder from a general contractor on a custom home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A strong luxury builder should be able to explain process, not just show finished photos. The most revealing questions are about similar projects, preconstruction planning, allowance setting, change order approval, quality control, and daily communication. Ask who actually manages the job on-site and how often budget and schedule are updated. It also helps to ask how the team handles long-lead items, specialty materials, and design coordination with consultants. Luxury homes often fail because of poor coordination rather than poor craftsmanship, so the builder’s systems matter as much as the final aesthetic. Homeowners should also ask for examples of homes with a similar budget, lot type, and design style. A builder who regularly handles custom high-end work should be able to describe how they prevent surprises before they happen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how similar projects were managed, who handles preconstruction, how allowances are set, how change orders are approved, and how the schedule is built. Also ask who will be on-site daily, how communication works, and how quality is checked at each stage. Luxury construction requires more coordination than basic residential work.
